content:
maria: Quick sync — need final benchmark narrative for Thurs webinar. Focus = latency vs cost tradeoffs + routing playbook for inbound leads. Need final 3 charts, a short copy deck, and 2 demo slices. Draft doc: https://docs.google.com/REDWOOD-BENCH (WIP)

alex: On it. I'll re-run microbenches for chat/embeddings/rerank with locked seq lengths. Proposal: seq=16/128/512 so charts compare consistent slices.

jordan: Thinking chart set: 1) scatter (p50 latency vs $/1k tokens) color by model variant, 2) slope chart showing cost per 1M tokens across batching configs, 3) demo-slice waterfall showing TTF token vs total generation time.

olivia: For webinar CTA + inbound routing: tag leads "bench-webinar" & ask a 1-question form: "Primary concern: latency, cost, or scale?" Route > $5k ARR -> AE, otherwise -> SDR. Also want a short SDR script.

maria: Love that. Alex — can you push the sample numbers matrix + PNGs by EOD so we can build slides? Also include 1-2 conservative tradeoff bullets we can read on stage.

alex: Pushed initial numbers and CSV: https://internal.redwood/bench/2214859012/results.csv
numbers (rough):
- chat @16 tokens: p50 latency 120ms, cost $0.12 / 1k tokens
- chat @512 tokens: p50 latency 420ms, cost $0.08 / 1k tokens
- embeddings (128): p50 latency 85ms, cost $0.03 / 1k tokens
- rerank (256): p50 latency 350ms, cost $0.26 / 1k tokens
PNG preview: https://internal.redwood/bench/2214859012/preview.png

jordan: These are helpful. Narrative note: lead with a simple customer problem: "interactive apps need <200ms TTF for good UX" — show how tuning batching + cache hits shifts you along the latency/cost curve. Call out low-cost bulk workloads (embeddings) vs low-latency slices (chat).

maria: I'll write slide copy. Need 3 talking points per slide: problem, measured tradeoff, action (what to change in infra/policy). Also include one-liner headline for social: "Make inference predictable: trade latency for cost where it matters."

olivia: Routing config example for ops slide (short):
```
routes:
  - priority: low-cost
    match: [embeddings, rerank]
    model: quantized-v2
  - priority: low-latency
    match: [chat]
    model: low-latency-accel
```
Use that to show how we keep interactive traffic snappy and batch the rest.

maria: For inbound/Sales: Olivia can you draft SDR script? Keep it 2 lines.

olivia: SDR script (draft): "Hi — saw you signed up for the benchmark webinar — quick Q: are you evaluating latency (interactive UX) or cost (scale)? If latency, I can loop in an AE for a quick latency-focused POC."

maria: Perfect. Final asks: please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the data + routing. We'll do a hard freeze on numbers at 2pm tomorrow then finalize slides.

alex: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

bench-bot: scheduled run complete — artifacts -> https://bench.redwood/internal/2214859012 (logs + csv + pngs)

olivia: Added the signup question to the landing page and pushed a copy tweak to staging.

maria: Thanks team — I'll collect slides and copy and share a review thread by 11am tomorrow. Closing loop after 2pm sync.
